$comment: Compass compliance-audit scoring rubric — OWNER-TUNABLE, no code change needed. Approved starting defaults (Nikhil, 2026-07-06): score = startScore - errorWeight*errors - warningWeight*warnings, floored at floor. Retune from real drift data later.

detect.$comment: Detect-step thresholds (per the approved detect-clustering design). hotspotMinBuilds: a {component,rule} cluster or assumption theme must appear in at least this many distinct builds to rank as a hotspot; below it = 'watching, not acting'. windowSize: default number of most-recent ledger entries Detect reads.

c7a.$comment: C7a static font declaration-consistency (built 2026-07-07 per owner grant; design: .compass-build/design/s4/c7-font-compliance.PROPOSED.md). OWNER-TUNABLE. missingFamilySeverity: a token-declared family with zero @font-face under that exact name (the S0 silent-fallback failure). weightGapSeverity: weights the typography spec lists but no hosted face covers. systemFamilies: stack entries that never need hosting (system/generic families).

c8.$comment: C8 invented, non-system CSS / motion (built 2026-07-19). Advisory WARNING only — never an error (owner ruling #10: token-audit is the sole gate). Flags *.module.css files, custom @keyframes, and non-system animation refs (CSS + inline-TSX) that bypass the Compass motion system (motion spec + tw-animate-css + shadcn presets). Never flags app/globals.css, the @acko tokens package, tw-animate-css, node_modules, or components/ui. systemAnimations: extra sanctioned animation names to treat as system-owned (merged with the motion-spec presets + Tailwind/tw-animate-css built-ins the check already knows).
